adversarial_load_context_check.verdict: No CONFIRMED URL-hiding hole found. Every row's context was compared with the browser's: script src / svg script href (any type, module, importmap, speculationrules with src, text/plain, nomodule) = Script: over-strict where a browser fetches nothing or blocks by MIME, never weaker; link rel tokens (ASCII whitespace incl. FF, case-insensitive, duplicate rel attribute dropped by the parser like browsers), alternate stylesheet = Stylesheet, invalid/missing/whitespace-padded preload as = Resource or stricter (browsers fetch nothing), modulepreload any as = Script (stricter than json/style module destinations); style media/type = scanned regardless; track any kind = Track (HTML requires a supported text track format, so text/css and the document itself fail: denial is over-strict); object/embed any type = Document (data: SVG/HTML/PDF denied); iframe srcdoc blank-by-ASCII skipped, else denied; meta refresh parse matches the shared declarative refresh steps (re-checked step by step incl. u/ur/url partial prefixes, '=' after whitespace, quote truncation, empty URL = self refresh = navigation); SMIL target: href before xlink:href (DOM attribute lookup is by qualified name, dom.rs:1333-1339), valueless href = parent (as Blink), '#' + id incl. percent-decoded and duplicate ids (union), any other spelling or missing target = Script+Resource.
adversarial_load_context_check.self_reference_spellings: '#', '#x', ' #', '\t#', '#', '#x', ' ', ' ', tab/newline, '' and valueless: denied in Stylesheet/Script/Track/Manifest, SameDocument elsewhere (resolves_to_document after url_clean). '?', '.', './', own file name, '?x', '%23': not resolves_to_document, reach the port (classify None, ambiguous_path false for these) - NOT hidden (css_url_gate.rs:999-1002 asserts ['?x','./']). See R13-P2 for what the port can decide.
checked_not_findings: @import "" / url() / url("") are skipped (cssurl.rs:842, :866): CSS Cascade 5 2 'If a <string> is provided, it must be interpreted as a <url> with the same value' and CSS Values 4 4.5.2 (empty URLs resolve to an invalid resource): nothing is fetched, consistent with the R10 lead acceptance; '@import " "' is denied (url_clean empties it).

use href ' #x' / '\t#x' = SameDocument (css_url_gate.rs:960): SVG 2 linking.html 16.1.7.1 decides same-document by comparing the absolute URL with the document URL, and 16.1.7.3 processes fetched subresource documents in secure static mode (no further fetches, no scripts).

new_findings.kind: hostile size (V4-02 class): super-linear work and allocation in new R12-P1 code, cancellation latency; not a URL-hiding finding
new_findings.file_line: handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-web/src/assets.rs:466-524 (animated_loads: :501 ids.get(fragment).cloned() copies every element with the id, :513-522 loops over all of them, each doing local_name allocation + attribute_path over the 61-row CARRIERS), called once per animation element whose attributeName is a URL target (assets.rs:1060-1063), with no memo per fragment and no cancel.check() inside; collect_assets checks cancellation only every 1024 node ids (assets.rs:1019-1022).
new_findings.evidence: Work = sum over URL-target animations of the number of elements sharing the fragment id. Within Limits::default (dom.rs:201-211: 8 MiB, 200000 nodes): <svg> + 100000 x '<g id="x"/>' (11 bytes) + 99000 x '<set href=#x attributeName=href />' (33 bytes) ~= 4.4 MB, ~199000 nodes, parses (self-closing foreign tags, duplicate ids allowed); every <set> clones a 100000-entry Vec (800 KB) and runs 100000 target iterations: ~1e10 attribute_path calls and ~80 GB of transient copies for one document; between two cancellation checks 1024 animations x 100000 targets ~= 1e8 iterations. Wall time not measured (no cargo by instruction; UNVERIFIED), order of tens of minutes by estimate. The lane note notes.remediation_R12pre.v4.V4-02 states 'animated_loads builds the id map once per document (O(nodes))', which omits the per-animation target scan. No test covers many animations x shared ids.
new_findings.remediation: Memoize the result per (fragment as written, its percent-decoded form, attribute name) in Collector (HashMap -> Loads), or fold targets to distinct (tag, link rel/as) before the union, and iterate the id list by reference instead of cloning it; check cancel inside the loop; add a hostile-size gate test (e.g. 50000 elements sharing an id x 50000 <set href=#id attributeName=href>) that completes within the existing 45 s bounded_case and still reports the expected contexts; update the V4-02 lane note.

new_findings.kind: self-reference hidden in one engine reading (R12-F2/P1 class, Gecko-only, low impact)
new_findings.file_line: handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-web/src/assets.rs:391-410 (value_pieces strips HTML space incl. U+000C; its own doc says Gecko SMILParserUtils::ParseValues strips SVG whitespace, 'which differs only in U+000C ... a C0 control the URL parser strips') with :843-848 (AnimationValues + Url target -> url_value per piece).
new_findings.evidence: <svg><script><animate attributeName="href" values="" dur="1s"/></script></svg>: the crate drops the piece (no row). Under the crate's own Gecko model the piece stays U+000C, the URL parser strips it to '' = the document, and the animated element is a script, i.e. the self-reference R12-F2 denies for to/from/by (url_value on the whole value, assets.rs:822-824) is not reported for values. Blink strips FF (piece empty, ignored) and SVG Animations 2.10 + SVG 2 TermWhiteSpaceCharacter include U+000C (fetched), so the hole exists only if Gecko keeps FF (UNVERIFIED, the crate's R11 note) AND an animated href starts an SVG script fetch (UNVERIFIED, R12-P1).
new_findings.remediation: For URL targets pass a piece that is non-empty before trimming but empty after the HTML-space trim to url_value as written (resolves_to_document then denies it in reads_text contexts, SameDocument elsewhere), or trim URL pieces with SVG 1.1 wsp (space, tab, LF, CR) only; add 'values=""' and 'values="a.png;"' under a script parent to r12_f2_animated_urls_take_the_load_context_of_the_animated_element.

new_findings.kind: port contract (lead decision): the lead-accepted 'the port decides' for document-resolving relative spellings has no load context to decide with
new_findings.file_line: handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-web/src/assets.rs:47-53 (AssetPort::resolve(&self, reference: &str): no load context; doc does not mention self-references), :132-144 (AssetRef carries no load context), src/lib.rs:46 DESCRIPTOR assets.port_called_for (no rule for references that resolve to the document).
new_findings.evidence: <link rel=stylesheet href="index.html"> (own file name), href="?", "." or "./" reach the port exactly like <a href="index.html"> (css_url_gate.rs:999-1002). A port that grants project files (the natural port for a preview) grants the HTML document for the link too, and the quirks-mode browser reads it as CSS (HTML stylesheet Quirk / CSS Cascade 5 2.3, fetched): the R12-F2 payload with href="index.html" loads https://evil.example/p.png with every row Granted. The same holds for any other granted non-CSS project file in a style sheet carrier and any granted text file in a script carrier. Lead ack 19:16:40Z accepted reporting these spellings to the port; the residual is recorded in notes.remediation_R12pre.residuals[0]; whether a real port would grant them is outside the crate (UNVERIFIED).
new_findings.remediation: Lead decision. Cheapest: one AssetPort doc line + DESCRIPTOR port_called_for: 'a reference that resolves to the document itself must not be granted (the port cannot tell a style sheet/script carrier from a link)'. Stronger: expose the carrier's load contexts (e.g. AssetRef::reads_text or a public load-context enum) and/or pass them to resolve (API change).

new_findings.remediation: Lead decision; cheap fail-closed variant: when refresh_url() is None and the content is not ASCII-blank, also report the legacy reading (skip ASCII whitespace and one ';' or ',', optional url= prefix and quotes) as a Document-context URL (union of readings, as R10 did for CSS).
